data.hypothesis: Testing an 8-thread CTA extends the existing block-size comparison below the previously tested 16-thread CTA. More, smaller CTAs could improve scheduling, but reduced lane utilization or additional scheduling overhead could instead make this configuration slower.
data.notes: This changes only launch geometry; the kernel traversal, equations, and memory behavior remain unchanged. In prior search observations, block 16 averaged 0.001797776 seconds, versus 0.001805407 for 32, 0.001811843 for 64, and the baseline block 256 at 0.001852641. Those aggregate results do not establish a benefit for block 8 or provide per-size breakdowns. The controller should validate all supported sizes before comparing official timings; no outcome is claimed for this candidate.
transformations: Set block and items_per_block to 8 and kept shared_memory_bytes at 0; left src/nbody_kernel.cu unchanged.
